2.3.5.3 The Table-2.13 presents the rate of Road Accidental Deaths per thousand registered motor vehicles in each state & UT during the year 1996. It is observed that although Maharashtra & Gujarat States had the highest and the second highest number of registered vehicles in the country, the rate of Accidental Death was highest in Arunachal Pradesh at 6.81 compared to 2.08 at national level. Mizoram stood 3rd with a rate of 4.5 after Himachal Pradesh with 5.96 accidental deaths per thousand vehicles.

2.3.5.4 In all 57,466 males and 12,334 females were fatally injured while travelling by various modes of transport on roads. Of these 18,388 persons (26.3%) were occupants of 'Truck or Lorry', 11592 (16.6%) were killed while travelling in buses while 7749 (11.1%) were pedestrians and 7,329 (10.5%) were riding on 'Two-wheelers'.
